title: [Refurbished] MacBook Pro 16-inch M4 Pro 14c/20c 24/512GB Silver $3529 Delivered @ Apple Stores
body:
Deal: [Refurbished] MacBook Pro 16-inch M4 Pro 14c/20c 24/512GB Silver $3529 Delivered @ Apple Stores

[Nedkellyinthebush] Yeah won’t cut it for me. RAM upgrades used to be double the previous standard, they should have done 32Gb the new minimum
[Nedkellyinthebush] Hard to call any Apple stuff a bargain after their major price hikes, and the end of the AOC store 🖕
[Mulberry3566] Even so, no bargains for Windows devices either
[Nedkellyinthebush] Well the situation is Sam Altman said personal computers are a waste of RAM and we the plebs do not deserve any lol
[Mulberry3566] For reference,
Apple Education Store (before any other discount)
14-Inch M6 24GB 1TB (this deal is 16 Inch) is $3309 & $3579 for the M5 Pro 24GB 1TB variant.
16-Inch only comes in M5 Pro 24GB/1TB minimum which is $4479
[DevilsInDetails] M6 lags far behind in GPU and memory bandwidth, so not directly comparable to me. And jfc they’re asking for $3.5K?
16-inch M5 Pro is good but I personally don’t find it worth the extra.
[Mulberry3566] Again, just for reference, to save people time because my first thought was “what were the prices from Apple Education”. I personally think the M4 Pro deal is “good” value + the giftcard deals given the current state of the world (not good).
[frkino] You said:
Thunderbolt 5 which is… let's say future proof […]
but iykyk, one of the highlights from the M4 series (and after) with thunderbolt 5 is: remote direct memory access (RDMA)
so, what you'd do is: carry a thunderbolt cable to plug into other's high memory machines and render off them (¬‿¬)
OzB-maxxing LoL
[DevilsInDetails] I’ve heard of the game but for 24G ram let’s just leave it here lol
